title: Request a repository
summary: Get a new GitHub repository created from a standard template with the right team permissions and branch protection.

resources.title: Skill: add a repository definition
resources.description: Lets an AI coding assistant add the definition file and open the pull request.

prerequisites.title: GitHub Enterprise account
prerequisites.description: Your account is linked to company SSO.

prerequisites.title: A GitHub team for your squad
prerequisites.description: The team gets write access to the new repository.

actors.name: You
actors.description: The engineer or BA following this process.

actors.name: Repository automation
actors.description: Pipeline that applies the repository definitions.

steps.title: Choose a name and a template
instructions: Pick a template: service-java, service-node, terraform-module or empty.
Decide the visibility: internal (default) or private.

steps.title: Add the repository definition
instructions: Create a branch in the github-repositories repo.
Add repos/<name>.yaml with name, template, team, visibility and application ID.

resources.title: Skill: add a repository definition
resources.description: Lets an AI coding assistant add the definition file and open the pull request.

steps.title: Create the repository
steps.description: Creates the repository from the template and applies branch protection and team access.

steps.title: Finish the repository setup
instructions: Update the README with a one-paragraph description.
Add the repository secrets your pipeline needs.

steps.title: Check the first pipeline run is green
instructions: Push a small change on a branch and open a pull request.
Check the build pipeline finishes successfully.
